features.title: Minimalist in form, powerful in use. Stay focused with Flow work desks—clean, modern surfaces designed for productivity and built to keep you efficient in today’s dynamic offices.
Minimalism with purpose. Flow desks provide clean lines and open surfaces that ease visual clutter, improving focus and well-being at work
Flow desks support healthy posture with ample legroom and balanced surface height, keeping you aligned and comfortable through long workdays.
Your desk should work as hard as you do. With a solid understructure and durable, scratch-resistant surface, Flow desks stand the test of time.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Flow 1200 X 600 Single Sided Workdesk
